test_title: PYST 27: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 2 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Eight girls M, N, O, P, Q, R, S and T are sitting around a circle facing towards the centre. Only three friends are sitting between P and S. M is sitting to the immediate right of S and to the immediate left of R. Only N is sitting between S and O. P is sitting second to the left of O. 

Who is sitting second to the left of P?
solution:
**Eight girls: ** M, N, O, P, Q, R, S and T are sitting around a circle facing towards the centre.

1) Only three friends are sitting between P and S.

2) M is sitting to the immediate right of S and to the immediate left of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0ca91a3ad66a6f2b74df363ecc9ea65e8af98c8dcd9553f9cf1b6b6820f697f.png] 

3) Only N is sitting between S and O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b6c06283c707355684d36f567619d9556687deaa5ae7ab22d4915276d3d821e.png] 

Clearly, R is sitting second to the left of P.

Hence, the correct answer is **"R".**
